name: Yellow Crane Tower
description: Yellow Crane Tower, a national 5A-level scenic spot, is known as the best tower in the world and the most beautiful scenery in the world. Together with Qingchuan Pavilion and Guqintai, it is also known as the three major scenic spots in Wuhan. The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the Sheshan Mountain Ridge in Wuchang on the south bank of the Yangtze River in Wuhan, Hubei Province, China. It was first built in the second year of Wu Huangwu (AD 223) during the Three Kingdoms period and has a history of more than 1,780 years. Its fame began to flourish in the Tang Dynasty. This was mainly due to the poet Cui Hao who had left the Yellow Crane in the past and left the Yellow Crane Tower here.
